name: tpl-precedence-1-goal
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(has_door_key) clause (R1) is redundant. The task's order chain (blocker_moved → has_door_key → door_open → target_picked_up) together with the final Existence(target_picked_up) already forces has_door_key, so this clause adds no new requirement and is an added clause. Remove the Existence(has_door_key) clause; the remaining Precedence and Existence clauses correctly capture the task.

texts: The ball must be moved away from the door before the key is taken.
The door must be opened only after the key is taken.
The target box must be picked up only after the door is open.
The target box must eventually be picked up.
